title: Taylor Swift Lasik Surgery Video on The Tonight Show
description: Luyện nghe và học từ vựng IELTS qua đoạn hội thoại giải trí, tự nhiên giữa Jimmy Fallon và Taylor Swift về video hài hước sau khi mổ mắt Lasik.
transcript:
- Can you see me by the way?
- Uh, yeah.
- Okay, good. 'Cause I just was wondering, 'cause I under-- Didn't you just get ___Lasik surgery___?
- I did. How do you know that?
- You got Lasik surgery, which is a ___major___ surgery.
- It i-- Yeah, but, um... I did, but I don't -- I don't even tell people that.
- But you can see me perfect? I just want to make sure, yeah.
- No, it was great. I really can see very well.
- Do you take ___painkillers___ or anything when you do that stuff? Well, I mean, do they give you like laughing gas or something?
- They definitely give you some pretty ___hard-core___ pills after you... have a laser in your eye. What is going on?

- What's happening right now?
- Your mom may or may not have ___videotaped___ you after surgery. And she gave us the video.
- For the television?
- Wait. This is a ___world premiere___. You got to check this out. This is Taylor Swift, post-surgery. You were, like, ___freaking out___ over a banana. Anyway, here's Taylor at home after her Lasik surgery. Video taken by her mom. Take a look at this. This is real.
- Okay, so, she found -- she found a ___snack___.
- That wasn't the one I wanted.

- Okay, I'm gonna get the other one for you. Okay.

- I'll eat it. I'll eat it. It's mine.
- But it doesn't have a head.
- Honey, it's fine. I don't need a head.
- Okay. I'm crying. I'm fine.
- Don't -- You don't want to cry. That's not what you want to do.
- Sometimes it doesn't go your way.
- Don't fall asleep eating a banana, okay?
- I'm not asleep. My mind is alive.
- Okay. Don't be mad. Don't be mad. Don't be mad at me. Don't be mad at me. I made some calls.
- Oh, my God!
- I may have made some calls.
- That's on television.
- Me and your mom -- You goes, "This one doesn't have a head. What are we gonna do with it?" Me and your mom stayed in touch.
- Wait. She was kind enough to drive me there but ___cruel___ enough to film it and give it to you?
- Yes, that's what -- That's what a good mom does.
- Ugh!
- I love you, Mom! That's what a good mom does.
- I was -- You notice the -- I had these ___goggles___ on, which are really ___high fashion___. But then they had to tape it to my head.
- Yeah, and you're not allowed to cry. And just -- Oh. The whole thing was so funny.
- But I was crying, I think, over a banana.
- Oh, my gosh. Oh, my God.
- Anyways, tell your mom thanks again for that. She's the best.
- You know what? I'm gonna tell her something.
- Let's talk "Saturday Night Live." You're on "SNL." You're great on "Saturday Night Live." And you're good at live. Last time I saw you was at the "Time 100" --
- I'm sorry. I can't think about anything else. I had like --
- Dude, it's my favorite. We watched it in the office like 20 times today. I'm like, "Oh, my God. This is not real. I can't believe we have this footage." You're like, going like, "But this is the wrong one. I wanted the other one." You're like, "What do we do with this banana?" And she's like, "We'll take care of it." You go, "But this doesn't have a --"
- "But its head is gone!"
- "It doesn't have a head." Oh, my gosh. It just was so cute. It made me laugh.
- Well, okay. So, I was at a party, like, a couple months ago, and I had like 2 1/2 mojitos. And then the next day, drunk -- #DrunkTaylor was like number-one ___trending___ on Twitter.
- Yeah, I saw that.
- Because, you know, I go, like, from zero to ___legitimately___ thinking I'm a wizard within like two drinks.
- "I'm a wizard." Yeah.
- Like, really thinking like --
- You were fun, though. You were dancing around doing -- you're dancing --
- Yeah, but thinking about the fact that that went as far as it did, and then we've got this happening...
- This would be -- This is Lasik.
- ...that you've done this now.
- This is Lasik lover. #LasikLover. #LasikLover. Um, "SNL" --
- I can't even be mad. I'm just ___impressed___ that you ___infiltrated___ my family. I don't even know how you did that. Nobody has my mom's number. Like, how did --
- Yeah, I asked for your mom's number. But, yeah, we've been friends for years.
- Oh, well, you know, news to me. This is great.
- What -- What songs are you doing on "SNL"? Can you say? Have you said?
- Yeah, I'm fine with saying.
- You can?
- I mean, I'll tell -- Well, you know, we gotta be a little ___cryptic___, just 'cause it's fun. But I'll probably do "Lover."
- Want to point at them? Ooh.
- I'll do "Lover," but in a way that I haven't performed it before, which -- And then I'm gonna do a song that I have never performed before at all, ___live___.
- Wow.
- So...
- That's a ___scoop___! I'll take that scoop. Taylor Swift, everybody.

vocabulary.example: She had Lasik surgery to correct her vision and no longer needs glasses.
Post-surgery care is crucial for a full and rapid recovery.
The doctor prescribed a strong painkiller after the medical operation.
They gave her some hard-core medication to handle the post-surgery pain.

vocabulary.meaning: Lâng lâng, lơ mơ, ngơ ngác (do thuốc)
vocabulary.example: The sedation made her feel completely loopy for a few hours.
Her mother decided to videotape her hilarious reaction while recovering.

vocabulary.meaning: Buổi công chiếu đầu tiên trên thế giới
vocabulary.example: The late-night show hosted the world premiere of the exclusive footage.

vocabulary.meaning: Hoảng loạn, cuống quýt, phát cuồng
vocabulary.example: She started to freak out over a broken banana after taking the medicine.
Taylor was amazed that Jimmy managed to infiltrate her family and get her mom's contact.
Patients must wear protective goggles after undergoing eye surgery.
She jokingly referred to her post-surgery protective eyewear as high fashion.

vocabulary.meaning: Đang thành xu hướng (mạng xã hội)
vocabulary.example: The funny video went viral and was trending at number one on social media.

vocabulary.meaning: Bí ẩn, khó hiểu, có ẩn ý
vocabulary.example: She gave a cryptic answer when asked about her upcoming music performance.

vocabulary.meaning: Tin độc quyền, thông tin sốt dẻo
vocabulary.example: Getting exclusive details about the new album was a massive scoop for the host.
Undergoing eye surgery is a major medical procedure that requires care.

vocabulary.meaning: Tàn nhẫn, độc ác (dùng trêu đùa)
vocabulary.example: She teased her mom for being cruel enough to share her embarrassing video.
After a couple of drinks, she legitimately believed she possessed magical powers.
She was genuinely impressed by how the talk show host obtained the video.
She promised to perform the new track live for the first time on the show.
While recovering from surgery, she tried to eat a banana as a simple snack.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the primary reason Jimmy Fallon brought up the subject of Lasik surgery?
options: To offer medical advice regarding eye operations.
To playfully introduce an embarrassing home video provided by Taylor's mother.
To criticize the clinic where Taylor underwent her procedure.
To promote a new brand of protective eyewear.

mcqQuestions.q: What caused Taylor Swift to cry in the video shown on TV?
options: She was experiencing severe physical pain from the laser surgery.
She broke off a banana that didn't have a 'head' and wasn't the exact one she wanted.
Her mother refused to give her any snacks or medication.
She was extremely angry at Jimmy Fallon for calling her.

mcqQuestions.q: When Taylor says "My mind is alive" while eating the banana, what does she mean?
options: She is experiencing hallucinations due to the medication.
She claims to be mentally conscious and awake despite looking sleepy and loopy.
She is planning her next studio album in her head.
She is having trouble controlling her eye movement.

mcqQuestions.q: How does Taylor react when she realizes the host got the video directly from her mother?
options: She gets furious and threatens to leave the show immediately.
She is humorously shocked and impressed that Jimmy managed to infiltrate her family.
She claims that the video is fake and generated by graphics.
She demands that the television network delete the recording.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Taylor say about her drinking tolerance when discussing the viral hashtag #DrunkTaylor?
options: She can drink heavily without feeling any psychological effects.
She quickly shifts from being sober to thinking she's a wizard after just two drinks.
She completely loses her memory after taking a single sip of alcohol.
She prefers drinking mojitos before performing live on stage.

mcqQuestions.q: What surprise or 'scoop' does Taylor share regarding her upcoming 'Saturday Night Live' appearance?
options: She will act as the head writer and host of the entire episode.
She will perform a song live that she has never performed anywhere before.
She plans to invite her mother on stage to recreate the banana video.
She will perform her set wearing post-surgery protective goggles.
